# Session 6 — v5.19-test, the test build with cheats

**Start check:** `grep -n '^version:\|^step:\|^round:\|^next:' docs/build/STATE.md | cut -c1-160` must show `version: 5.19-test`. If `round` is r2 or r3, continue from what `step` and `next:` say.

**VERSION file:** `docs/build/v5.19-test/VERSION.md`.

## Do
1. Wave 1: **X1**. When it reports, run `npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -3` and `npm test 2>&1 | tail -4`, then commit.
2. Wave 2: **X2 ‖ X3** (two programmers, the limit). Wave 3: **X4**.
3. Verify as VERSION.md's "Verify for this step" says: the README block with `V=5.19` (never `5.19-test`: APP_VERSION does not change) and `L=v5.19-test`, the `TEST MODE PANEL` grep on `dist/`, then the test export and its shots. The normal run must show 0 new and 0 changed shots; a changed shot goes to the lane that draws it, like a failed test.
4. Commit, the r1 reviews VERSION.md lists (codecritic full on the session's model; critic low on Sonnet on the panel shots), gate, fix rounds per the README, using VERSION.md's "Fix routing".
5. Close per README section 8 with `V=5.19-test` in the log lines (skip the `loop_stats.py` line if it can't read this step, and say so in the PR body). Then set STATE: `version: 5.20`, `step: waves`, `round: r1`, `last_shots: v5.19-test` (or the last round's label), `next: wait for Julien to set v5.20 scope`, and keep the `open:` line as it is.

## Context rules (they outrank habit; the README's rules still apply)
- Read these files and no others: this one, `docs/build/README.md`, `docs/build/STATE.md`, and the one VERSION file named above. Never a card, review, source file, log, screenshot, diff body, or another file in this folder.
- Every command you run ends in `| tail -n N` (N ≤ 15), `| grep …`, or a redirect to a file.
- Agents: only the types README section 3 lists, always in the background, card passed by path with the README's spawn prompt and this one added line: `Keep your final report under 12 lines.` Never Explore, Plan or general-purpose. Do not poll and do not open an agent's transcript.
- From an agent's report keep one word per card (and the `Needs:` line if there is one). Write it to STATE at once, so nothing depends on your memory of the report.
- Update STATE after every wave. If your context is summarised, or you have run two fix rounds, finish the current step, write an exact `next:` line, do the "End" steps below and stop.
- Load no skill and no extra tool except the one that opens the pull request at the end.
- Ask Julien only what README section 4 says to ask. Otherwise apply the defaults in the VERSION file.

## End
- Commit and push as README section 6 says (the session's own branch, never `main`).
- Open one pull request from that branch to `main` (DECISIONS #34). Title: the commit's first line. Body: three lines at most (what ran, the gate result, what is next), then the attribution lines. Do not watch it.
- Tell Julien in 2 to 4 sentences: verdicts or checks, bugs and majors only, the PR link, and this line: **After merging, publish the test build: paste "Read claude/PUBLISH-RUNBOOK.md and carry out the TEST build prompt inside it exactly." into a new session in the Pizza Game project.** Then stop.
